title: Civil Judge (Junior Division)
qualification: A person who is not a citizen of India, or who is dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from Judicial Service or any service of the Government, Statutory or Local Authority. || A person convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, or arrested in connection with any such crime. || A person permanently debarred or disqualified by the High Court, UPSC or any State Public Service Commission from examinations or selections. || A person who directly or indirectly influences the recruitment authority for his/her candidature. || A person having more than one wife living, or a woman who marries knowingly a person having a wife. || A candidate who has committed copying or misconduct in a Screening Test/Written Examination, or could not successfully complete the probation period of any post in Judicial Service or other service. || An officer found to be of doubtful integrity in any year.
salary: The pay and stipend details given in the notification are as follows: || Pay Scale:Rs. 77,840 - 1,36,520 for Civil Judge (Junior Division). || Training Period (1 year at the Judicial Academy):Selected candidates are designated as "Trainee Judicial Officers" and are paid a fixed emolument equivalent to one-half of the remuneration payable to a Civil Judge (Junior Division), along with the facilities and benefits ordinarily available to trainees in the Academy. || Law Clerkship (1 year):After the training, Trainee Judicial Officers undergo one year of structured Law Clerkship, with the same emoluments as during their training and no further allowance. The first six months are under the supervision of the Principal District/District and Sessions Judges or Members of the Higher Judicial Services, and the remaining six months under an Hon'ble Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. || Regular Appointment:On completion of the Law Clerkship, the Hon'ble Judge places a reasoned evaluation report. If found satisfactory, the Trainee Judicial Officer is appointed to the regular post and is entitled to the regular pay scale and other service benefits.
age_limit: Age is calculated as on 01-09-2026, the first day of the month in which the notification was published.
application_fee: Open Category/EWS/BC Candidates:Rs. 1,500/- towards online application processing fee and examination fee. || SC/ST/Persons with Benchmark Disabilities:Rs. 750/-. Only applicants belonging to a community recognized as SC/ST in the State of Andhra Pradesh are entitled to this concession. || Payment Mode:Online only. || The application/examination fee once paid will not be refunded, even if the application is rejected for any reason or the notification is cancelled.
selection_process: The selection process for Direct Recruitment consists of the following stages: Screening Test, Written Examination and Viva Voce.

age_limit: The uploaded apprenticeship notification does not specify a separate minimum or maximum numerical age limit. Candidates should follow the eligibility requirements under the applicable apprenticeship rules and the official application portals. selection_process: Selection for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship 2026 will be based on academic merit and document verification. The notification provides for category-wise merit lists using the marks obtained in the relevant educational qualification. It does not announce a separate written examination or interview as part of the stated selection procedure. || Academic Merit List:Merit lists will be prepared based on academic scores separately for UR, OBC, SC, ST and EWS categories. || Discipline-Wise Shortlisting:Applicants will be shortlisted according to their position in the merit list for the relevant discipline, branch, trade or subject. || Document Verification:Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend document verification with original certificates. || Final Consideration:Only candidates who attend verification and satisfy all prescribed eligibility requirements will be considered for apprenticeship engagement. || No travelling allowance will be provided to candidates attending document verification. Selection is subject to satisfactory verification of qualifications, marks and supporting documents.
